name: 選んだ食材の量と除外を調整する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE complete Japanese Lighthouse ingredient quantity/exclusion picker LH19-0005, portrait compact composition, pure white canvas.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: image1 ORIGINAL sweetgreen screen has HIGHEST priority for exact minus glyph geometry, circular controls, quantity indicators, icon optical weight, spacing and precise selection detail. Image2 is the ORIGINAL unselected state with all six food photos and highest authority for their anatomy/crops. Image3 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY content/layout only; do not reproduce rough substitute icons. Image4 is the exact ORIGINAL arugula crop. Image5 is generated v001 CORRECTION TARGET; keep its white surfaces and green selected outlines/counts. All six individual original food crops were inspected: arugula scattered thin leaves/stems; baby spinach three broad leaves; romaine leafy upright wedge; quinoa warm granular mound; kale frilled stem leaf; spring mix four differently shaped green/red leaves. Preserve actual food shapes, arrangement and colors shown in original screens, no substitutes. Tool accepts at most5 inputs so the other five inspected crops are represented by the original source screen.
Component contains section 「選んだ食材」 with TWO selected cards: 「ルッコラ」 and 「ベビーほうれん草」, each food photo, lower-left white neutral thin-outline circular MINUS with crisp horizontal line, lower-right green circular 「1」 quantity indicator. Then fine neutral divider and heading 「ベース」. Below a THREE-column TWO-row grid of SIX cards:
row1 「ルッコラ」, 「ベビーほうれん草」, 「刻みロメインレタス」
row2 「ハーブ入りキヌア」, 「刻みケール」, 「ミックスリーフ」.
First two grid cards are selected, with same minus and quantity1; other four are unselected and have no added quantity, plus, checkmark or removal controls. All food photos appropriate to exact crop. Preserve 2 selected summary cards and 6 candidate cards, not 8 unique foods.
White rounded cards, neutral hairline borders, restrained soft shadow, selected cards distinguished by forest-green outline plus count1; keep interiors white instead of source broad green/beige cards. Photo background beige may remain only inside original crop. Green count circles subtle gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, white numerals. Minus slate #526173, other text ink. This purposeful selected-state green is the only UI accent. Do not remove selection distinction or turn every card green.
Typography locked Meiryo heading Bold20/28 for ベース, compact section role preserved, body Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0. Targeted correction: the romaine caption MUST be two lines exactly 「刻みロメイン」 on first line and 「レタス」 on second line, as the saved Japanese mock. Do not shrink its type to force one line. Other names remain matching mock. Preserve original photographs from images1/2/4 rather than inventing new leaf shapes. Keep v001 control positions, all 4 minus/count1 pairs, all2+6 cards, and text unchanged otherwise. Wrap long ingredient names without clipping. No title above 選んだ食材, no extra photos, hidden/cropped lower source candidates, price, total, footer buttons, navigation or confirmation. Render the complete target in modest compact whitespace, no heavy gloss, broad tint, watermark.
reviewNotes: 2回目を実見、刻みロメイン／レタスを2行へ修正。選択済2＋候補6、4組の除外と数量1、白面と森林色選択を保持。元写真との葉形・表面の再描画差は残り、厳密なアート保持は未認定。2回限定の試行を保存し未受入として続行。所有者承認・編集可能性・自動連動・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
